audience: coaches, consultants, authors, and executives who have spoken at a few events and want more consistent bookings
core_pain: most speakers wait to be invited — stages don't send invites, you have to find them and pitch
tone: confident, direct, knowledgeable, never salesy, never hype-y
casing: sentence case always — never title case, never all caps
sentence_style: short sentences. punchy. one idea per line where possible.
cta_style: soft — never pushy. 'DM us the word stages' or 'link in bio' only
visual_hypothesis: dark navy (#0B1120) + teal (#1DA884) — brand consistency with Reeve. testable against white + teal in Phase 2.

reeve_service.what_we_do: Reeve is a systematic outreach operation that handles everything between 'I have a great talk' and 'here's your flight confirmation.' Each week we scan hundreds of conferences and corporate events for open speaker opportunities, write targeted pitches to decision makers, follow up strategically, and negotiate terms. Clients show up and speak. We handle the pipeline.
reeve_service.service_model: monthly retainer — clients pay for consistent outbound pipeline work, not per-booking commissions
what_clients_get: weekly pipeline of qualified event opportunities
pitch writing tailored to each event organizer
systematic follow-up on every open conversation
negotiation support on fees and terms
reeve_service.differentiation: Unlike bureaus (which wait for inbound and take 20-30% commission), Reeve builds outbound pipeline. We pitch, we follow up, we find the events. Speakers don't wait — they get scheduled.
reeve_service.who_its_for: Speakers who have a talk worth giving and want the business side handled — not speakers looking for their first gig.
